what: New Tracker skills section: .octo-feather.toml tracker config, the self-contained github-pr, github-issues and linear skills (each with its scripts and CLI fake), the {tracker} role line, the seven fixed tracker scripts every tracker skill implements, like-for-like tracker writes; the local github row splits into the three skills. Adds acceptance-tracker-linear, -default, -unknown, -scripts and story-tracker.
why: Owner ruling (Tom, 2026-10-22, issue #82): feather works with Linear directly so it can run on Turbo-Outreach; the tracker is set per target in .octo-feather.toml, tracker work lives in packaged skills (github-pr, github-issues, linear) behind fixed script names, and ADR 0004 and 0011 were corrected in place to match.
evidence: Corrected ADR 0004 says the tracker is GitHub Issues or Linear, chosen per target, and ADR 0011 that a Linear lane's key is its lowercased ticket key, while the spec as accepted says 'github: Issues, pull requests and consent rules' (local-github) and 'ADR 0004 GitHub Issues' (skill-to-tickets); the accepted criteria cannot pass on a Linear target, which Turbo-Outreach is.
